name: UML Class Diagrams
practice_prompt: Coach the student to sketch a class diagram for a library system. Follow: end-in-mind → classes → attributes → relationships. Nudge if they skip ahead.

practice_stages.label: end in mind
practice_stages.focus: Clarify what we're modeling — a library system class diagram. Ask what entities they expect.

practice_stages.label: classes
practice_stages.focus: Name the main classes (Book, Member, Loan, etc.). Ask the student to identify them first.

practice_stages.label: attributes
practice_stages.focus: Add key attributes to one or two classes. Ask what data each class needs.

practice_stages.label: relationships
practice_stages.focus: Connect classes — association or inheritance. Ask how classes relate (e.g. Member borrows Book).

final_example: Classes: Book, Member, Librarian, Loan with attributes and associations like Member borrows Book via Loan.
check_questions: What three parts does a class show in a UML class diagram?
What is the difference between association and inheritance?
Give a simple real-world example of two related classes.
